A. 340 To Moses Harrington Register of Wills in and for Kent County: Dr. Isaac Jump Admn. of James Morgan Dec. represents that on the 11th day of May AD 1868 he passed before the Said Register the 2nd and final account & his said Administration, showing an unappropriated Ballance in his hands of $399.74 with interest from March 30th 1868. that the deceased died Intestate leaving to Survive him a widow and six children. The widow having been provided for by the Orphans Court, the childrn are all living and entitled to the Said Ballance as follows: to Samuel Thomas Morgan 1/6, to William Francis Morgan 1/6, To Roxanna Morgan 1/6, to James Henry Morgan 1/6, Napoleon Morgan 1/6, Rosella Morgan 1/6 upon this Statement the Said Administrator presents the following account for distribution and prays its allowance. Morgan to Dr. Isaac Jump 5 May 1873 Rec 4 - 365 Reg. fee - $1.50 Know all men by these presents that William Francis Morgan one of the Heirs at Law of James Morgan Dec acknowledge to have this day Received from Dr. Isaac Jump Adm. of Said deceased the sum of Eighty five dollars and Sixty Six Cents in full for my distributive share from the estate of Said deceased as per a distributive account passed before the Register of Kent County May 11, 1868. And I do hereby (unclear) acquit and forever discharge him the Said Dr. Isaac Jump Adm. as aforesaid of and from all liability or accountability to me my heirs Executors administrators or assigns for by reason or an account of my distributive share from the Estate of Said deceased hereby acknowledging myself fully Satisfied and paid all received due me. As Setting my hand and Seal this the 5 day of May, AD 1873 (signed) William Francis (HIS MARK) Morgan
